notes:
NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no Tz'utujil row. The page has no extent, rulers or dates before 1523. The Tz'utujil page says 1523 for Alvarado's defeat of them (with the Kaqchikel); the Spanish conquest page says 18 April 1524. The Tz'utujil page puts the capital at Chuitinamit near Santiago Atitlán, not Tecpán Atitlán (the conquest page's name for the deserted town found the next day).
GAZETTEER. No Lake Atitlán or Santiago Atitlán in the gazetteer (Sololá admin1 exists).
